natspec.notice: One-shot initializer for the ERC-20 Permit (ERC-2612) extension — seeds the EIP-712 domain and nonce storage {ERC20Permit} builds its digest over, then registers IERC20Permit via ERC-165. The EIP-712 domain uses the token `name_` and version "1". Delegatecalled by {Diamond.initialize} (through {MultiInit}) inside the initializing window opened by the diamond, alongside the base {ERC20Init}; it must NOT open its own pre/postInitializer.
